subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 3: '-sh' at the end of words (wish, fish, cash, push)

show.line: sh can come at the end too. Fish, wish, push! And th says th, as in think.

rounds.prompt: Say the sound with me. th, as in thank you!
Where is the sh? At the start or at the end?

hints: For th, put your tongue between your teeth.
Listen to the end of the word. Fish, sh.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this word.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It says fish. sh at the end.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. f, i, sh. Fish!

parent_line: Can read sh at the end of words and th at the start: fish, wish, think.
